```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE,results='asis'}
library(this.path)
library(knitr) 
source(file.path(this.path::this.dir() , "06_validationMatrix.R"))
library(kableExtra)
library(terra)
library(Metrics)
library(gt)
library(tidyverse)
library(yardstick)

todos <- list(
"CZ-AT" = list( pred  = terra::rast("/archivio/shared/geodati/wildfire/zenodoV11/drive-download-20260519T155402Z-3-001/pilotRegions_AT-CZ_FuelModelprobs.tif") ,
                  obs1 = terra::rast("/archivio/shared/R/wildfire/data/validation/thayatal_forest_fuel_3416.tif") ,
                  obs2 = terra::rast("/archivio/shared/R/wildfire/data/validation/WildfireCE_Fuel_map_validation_AT-CZ_CzechGlobe_model.tif") 
            ),

"AT-IT-SI" = list(pred = terra::rast("/archivio/shared/geodati/wildfire/zenodoV11/drive-download-20260519T155402Z-3-001/pilotRegions_AT-IT-SI_FuelModelprobs.tif") ,
                  obs1 = terra::rast("/archivio/shared/R/wildfire/data/validation/carinthia_forest_fuel_3416.tif")
               
             ),

"DE-CZ" = list(pred = terra::rast("/archivio/shared/geodati/wildfire/zenodoV11/drive-download-20260519T155402Z-3-001/pilotRegions_CZ-DE_FuelModelprobs.tif"),
                  obs1 = terra::rast("/archivio/shared/R/wildfire/data/validation/WildfireCE_Fuel_map_validation_DE-CZ_CzechGlobe_model.tif")
             )
)

  
```





```{r  echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE,results='asis'}

risultati <- list()
for(area in names(todos) ){ 
  pred <- todos[[area]][["pred"]][[2]]
  ref <- todos[[area]][["obs1"]]
  ref2 <- todos[[area]][["obs2"]]
 
  k <- errorTables(ref, pred, area)
  cat("\\newpage\n") 
  cat("\n\n# VALIDATION ON: ", terra::names(ref), "\n\n" ) 
  cat("\\newpage\n") 
  for(t in k){  
    print(t)
    cat("\\newpage\n")  
  }
  
  if(!is.null(ref2)){
       k <- errorTables(ref2, pred, paste0(area,"2"))
      cat("\\newpage\n") 
      cat("\n\n# VALIDATION ON: ", terra::names(ref2), "\n\n" ) 
      cat("\\newpage\n") 
      for(t in k){   
        print(t)
        cat("\\newpage\n")  
      }
  }

}
```
